claim: The blood-brain barrier (BBB) interferes with the treatment of central nervous system disorders owing to the complexity of its structure and restrictive function.
source: The blood-brain barrier (BBB) interferes with the treatment of central nervous system disorders owing to the complexity of its structure and restrictive function.
evidence: This is a statement of established scientific knowledge about the BBB's role in limiting drug delivery to the CNS.

claim: Specific mode electroacupuncture (EA) stimulation can effectively open the BBB in rats.
source: Specific mode electroacupuncture (EA) stimulation can effectively open the BBB in rats.
evidence: This claim is supported by the authors' previous research cited in the introduction and the current study's experimental design.

claim: The study used single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) to comprehensively map the cell population in the Sprague-Dawley rat cerebral cortex.
source: Here, we used single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) to comprehensively map the cell population in the Sprague-Dawley rat cerebral cortex.
evidence: This is a direct statement of the methodology used in the study.

claim: The study identified 23 cell subsets in the brain.
source: We identified 23 cell subsets and eight types of cells in the brain by cell annotation.
evidence: This is a primary finding directly stated in the abstract and supported by the results section.

claim: The study identified eight types of cells in the brain by cell annotation.
source: We identified 23 cell subsets and eight types of cells in the brain by cell annotation.
evidence: This is a primary finding directly stated in the abstract and supported by the results section.

claim: scRNA-seq revealed transcriptional changes in the cerebral cortex under EA.
source: scRNA-seq revealed transcriptional changes in the cerebral cortex under EA.
evidence: This is a primary finding of the study supported by the differential gene expression analyses presented in the results.

claim: The blood-brain barrier mainly comprises specialized brain endothelial cells with tight junctions, a basement membrane, neurons, pericytes, and astrocytes.
source: The blood-brain barrier (BBB), which is crucial for drug delivery to the brain, mainly comprises specialized brain endothelial cells with tight junctions, a basement membrane, neurons, pericytes, and astrocytes.
evidence: This is established scientific knowledge about BBB composition.

claim: Single-cell RNA sequencing can systematically identify cell types and post-intervention molecular changes by analyzing the gene expression profiles of individual cells.
source: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) can systematically identify cell types and post-intervention molecular changes by analyzing the gene expression profiles of individual cells.
evidence: This is established knowledge about the capabilities of scRNA-seq technology.

claim: Specific mode EA at head stimulation points (Baihui and Shuigou acupoints), using parameters of '2/100 Hz, 3 mA, 6 s-6 s, 40 min,' can produce a significant and effective BBB opening effect.
source: Our previous studies have shown that specific mode electroacupuncture (EA) at head stimulation points (Baihui and Shuigou acupoints), using parameters of '2/100 Hz, 3 mA, 6 s-6 s, 40 min,' can produce a significant and effective BBB opening effect, promoting the entry of Evans blue and FITC-Dextran of different molecular weights into the brain, with the permeability effect being more prominent in the frontal lobe region. (Zhang et al., 2018; Zhang et al., 2020; Ma et al., 2022; Lin et al., 2023; Ma et al., 2024; Dai et al., 2025).
evidence: This claim is supported by multiple citations to the authors' previous work.

claim: EA-induced BBB opening promotes the entry of Evans blue and FITC-Dextran of different molecular weights into the brain.
source: Our previous studies have shown that specific mode electroacupuncture (EA) at head stimulation points (Baihui and Shuigou acupoints), using parameters of '2/100 Hz, 3 mA, 6 s-6 s, 40 min,' can produce a significant and effective BBB opening effect, promoting the entry of Evans blue and FITC-Dextran of different molecular weights into the brain, with the permeability effect being more prominent in the frontal lobe region. (Zhang et al., 2018; Zhang et al., 2020; Ma et al., 2022; Lin et al., 2023; Ma et al., 2024; Dai et al., 2025).
evidence: This claim is supported by citations to previous studies by the authors.

claim: The permeability effect of EA-induced BBB opening is more prominent in the frontal lobe region.
source: Our previous studies have shown that specific mode electroacupuncture (EA) at head stimulation points (Baihui and Shuigou acupoints), using parameters of '2/100 Hz, 3 mA, 6 s-6 s, 40 min,' can produce a significant and effective BBB opening effect, promoting the entry of Evans blue and FITC-Dextran of different molecular weights into the brain, with the permeability effect being more prominent in the frontal lobe region. (Zhang et al., 2018; Zhang et al., 2020; Ma et al., 2022; Lin et al., 2023; Ma et al., 2024; Dai et al., 2025).
evidence: This claim is supported by citations to previous studies and justifies the focus on the frontal cortex in the current study.

claim: EA-induced BBB opening exhibits stimulus dependency and a time window effect.
source: In addition, we found that EA-induced BBB opening exhibits stimulus dependency and a time window effect.
evidence: This is stated as a finding from the authors' previous research.

claim: The study covers approximately 98,338 cells from 10 samples.
source: We addressed this challenge by presenting a comprehensive single-cell molecular map of the rat frontal cortex, which covers approximately 98,338 cells from 10 samples, including freshly excised cortical brain tissue after EA intervention and responsive tissue from the control group.
evidence: This is a direct statement of the sample size in the study.

claim: The study characterized 23 clusters in the rat frontal cortex, including eight annotated cell types.
source: We characterized 23 clusters in the rat frontal cortex, including eight annotated cell types.
evidence: This is a primary finding of the study stated in the introduction.

claim: Male Sprague–Dawley rats, 8–10 weeks old and weighing 180–220 g, were used in the study.
source: Male Sprague–Dawley rats (Specific Pathogen Free), 8–10 weeks old and weighing 180–220 g, were obtained from Shanghai Sipul-Bike Experimental Animal Company.
evidence: This is a direct statement of the animal model characteristics used in the study.

claim: Rats were housed under a 12 hr light/dark cycle with food and water given ad libitum.
source: All rats were housed in the Zhejiang Chinese Medical University Laboratory Animal Research Center under a 12 hr light/dark cycle with food and water given ad libitum.
evidence: This is a direct statement of the housing conditions.

claim: Rats were randomly assigned to the EA and CON groups (n=5 per group).
source: Rats were randomly assigned to the EA and CON groups (n=5 per group).
evidence: This is a direct statement of the experimental design.

claim: The EA group received EA at GV20 (Baihui) and GV26 (Shuigou) acupuncture points.
source: The GV20 (Baihui) and GV26 (Shuigou) acupuncture points were selected, with needle dimensions of 25 mm × 0.13 mm for GV20 and 16 mm × 0.07 mm for GV26.
evidence: This is a direct statement of the EA intervention protocol.

claim: The EA stimulation current was set at 3 mA at a frequency of 2/100 Hz, and the stimulation lasted for 40 min.
source: The current was set at 3 mA at a frequency of 2/100 Hz, and the stimulation lasted for 40 min.
evidence: This is a direct statement of the EA parameters used.

claim: From five EA and five CON samples, 98,338 single cells were captured using the 10X Genomics Chromium Single Cell 3' solution.
source: From five EA and five CON samples, 98,338 single cells were captured using the 10X Genomics Chromium Single Cell 3' solution.
evidence: This is a direct statement of the number of cells captured in the sequencing.

claim: After quality control filtering, 80,713 cells were included in the analysis.
source: Quality control filtered cells with fewer than 500 expressed genes, UMI counts below 500, and >25% mitochondrial DNA-derived gene expression; as a result, 80,713 cells were included in the analysis.
evidence: This is a direct statement of the number of cells after quality control.

claim: Twenty-three clusters (cluster 0–cluster 22) were obtained by cell subgroup classification.
source: Twenty-three clusters (cluster 0–cluster 22) were obtained by cell subgroup classification.
evidence: This is a primary finding stated in the results section.

claim: Eight cell types were identified: endothelial cells, astrocytes, microglia, oligodendrocytes, T cells, border-associated macrophages (BAMs), fibroblasts, and granulocytes.
source: In addition to endothelial cells, we identified astrocytes, microglia, oligodendrocytes, T cells, border-associated macrophages (BAMs), fibroblasts, and granulocytes in this dataset (Figure 2a and b).
evidence: This is a primary finding stated in the results and shown in Figure 2.

claim: Endothelial cells were enriched in two subpopulations.
source: The combined analysis of cell clustering (Figure 1d) and cell identification showed that endothelial cells were enriched in two subpopulations, astrocytes were enriched in six subpopulations, and microglial marker genes were enriched in 10 subpopulations.
evidence: This is a finding from the cell type identification analysis.

claim: Astrocytes were enriched in six subpopulations.
source: The combined analysis of cell clustering (Figure 1d) and cell identification showed that endothelial cells were enriched in two subpopulations, astrocytes were enriched in six subpopulations, and microglial marker genes were enriched in 10 subpopulations.
evidence: This is a finding from the cell type identification analysis.

claim: Microglial marker genes were enriched in 10 subpopulations.
source: The combined analysis of cell clustering (Figure 1d) and cell identification showed that endothelial cells were enriched in two subpopulations, astrocytes were enriched in six subpopulations, and microglial marker genes were enriched in 10 subpopulations.
evidence: This is a finding from the cell type identification analysis.

claim: In endothelial cells, the expression of 147 genes was significantly increased and 160 genes was markedly downregulated (logFC = 0.26, p<0.01).
source: The expression of a total of 147 genes was significantly increased, and that of 160 genes was markedly downregulated (logFC = 0.26, p<0.01).
evidence: This is a primary finding from the differential gene expression analysis of endothelial cells.

claim: GO analysis of endothelial cell DEGs demonstrated the enrichment of 42 GO terms related to the BBB (p<0.05, count ≥3).
source: To perform enrichment analysis to evaluate the functionality of the 307 genes, we used the Gene Ontology (GO) terms, which encompassed biological processes (BPs), cellular components (CCs), and molecular function (MF), demonstrating the enrichment of 42 GO terms related to the BBB (p<0.05, count ≥3) (Figure 3c).
evidence: This is a finding from the GO enrichment analysis of endothelial cells.

claim: KEGG analysis of endothelial cell DEGs yielded nine pathways that may be associated with BBB function: tight junctions, endocytosis, focal adhesion, the PI3K/Akt signaling pathway, the MAPK signaling pathway, the HIF-1 signaling pathway, the JAK/STAT signaling pathway, ferroptosis, and cell adhesion molecules.
source: KEGG analysis yielded nine pathways that may be associated with BBB function: tight junctions, endocytosis, focal adhesion, the phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase (PI3K)/Akt signaling pathway, the mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK) signaling pathway, the hypoxia-inducible factor 1 (HIF-1) signaling pathway, the Janus kinase/signal transducer and activator of transcription (JAK/STAT) signaling pathway, ferroptosis, and cell adhesion molecules (Figure 3b).
evidence: This is a finding from the KEGG pathway enrichment analysis of endothelial cells.

claim: Gene set enrichment analysis (q<0.05) of endothelial cells revealed eight significantly enriched unique pathways: complement and coagulation cascades, ribosomes, lysosomes, cardiac muscle contraction, the rig I-like receptor signaling pathway, proteasomes, antigen processing and presentation, and cytokine-cytokine receptor interactions.
source: Computational gene set enrichment analysis (q<0.05) revealed eight significantly enriched unique pathways and identified the following BPs as being affected by EA: complement and coagulation cascades, ribosomes, lysosomes, cardiac muscle contraction, the rig I-like receptor signaling pathway, proteasomes, antigen processing and presentation, and cytokine-cytokine receptor interactions (Figure 4).
evidence: This is a finding from the GSEA analysis of endothelial cells.

claim: In astrocytes, DEG analysis identified 24 downregulated and three upregulated genes.
source: DEG analysis identified 24 downregulated and three upregulated genes, and the top 10 most upregulated and top three most downregulated genes are shown in Figure 5a.
evidence: This is a primary finding from the differential gene expression analysis of astrocytes.

claim: DEGs in astrocytes were mainly enriched in calcium-related terms, ATP and ADP synthesis and metabolism, and the nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide dehydrogenase complex.
source: GO was performed. KEGG analyses revealed that DEGs were mainly enriched in calcium-related terms, adenosine triphosphate (ATP) and adenosine diphosphate synthesis and metabolism, and the nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide dehydrogenase complex.
evidence: This is a finding from the GO and KEGG enrichment analyses of astrocyte DEGs.

claim: Astrocyte DEGs are involved in pathways connected to BBB function and permeability, including positive regulation of vascular permeability, cellular response to the vascular endothelial growth factor stimulus, endothelial cell chemotaxis, and the platelet-derived growth factor receptor signaling pathway.
source: These molecules are prominent in certain pathways that may be connected to BBB function and permeability, including positive regulation of vascular permeability, cellular response to the vascular endothelial growth factor stimulus, endothelial cell chemotaxis, and the platelet-derived growth factor receptor signaling pathway (Figure 5b and c).
evidence: This is a finding from the pathway enrichment analysis of astrocyte DEGs.

claim: EA produced an immediate damage-associated molecular pattern response in microglia, including the co-chaperone of the heat shock protein 70, DNAJ protein family (Dnaja1 and Dnajb1), related to the inflammatory response.
source: EA produced an immediate damage-associated molecular pattern response and the co-chaperone of the heat shock protein 70, DNAJ protein family (Dnaja1 and Dnajb1), related to the inflammatory response (Cao et al., 2014; Kovacs et al., 2017).
evidence: This is a finding from the microglial DEG analysis, supported by citations.

claim: GO analysis of microglial DEGs showed terms mainly classified into five categories: calcium signaling, MAPK-related pathways, chemokine pathways, extracellular function, and angiogenesis.
source: According to the GO analysis, the terms associated with DEGs were mainly classified into five categories: calcium signaling, MAPK-related pathways, chemokine pathways, extracellular function, and angiogenesis (Figure 6c).
evidence: This is a finding from the GO enrichment analysis of microglial DEGs.

claim: KEGG analysis of microglial DEGs showed pathways that may be related to BBB function: the MAPK signaling pathway, endocytosis, HIF-1 signaling pathway, PI3K-Akt signaling pathway, TNF signaling pathway, cell adhesion molecules, Wnt signaling pathway, and tight junctions.
source: Figure 6b shows the results of functional enrichment in the KEGG pathway database, which may be related to BBB function: the MAPK signaling pathway, endocytosis, HIF-1 signaling pathway, PI3K-Akt signaling pathway, tumor necrosis factor (TNF) signaling pathway, cell adhesion molecules, Wnt signaling pathway, and tight junctions.
evidence: This is a finding from the KEGG pathway enrichment analysis of microglial DEGs.

claim: Four endothelial cell clusters (clusters 0, 2, 4, and 5) were dominant between the EA and control groups.
source: The single-cell analysis identified 23 EC subgroups, of which four clusters (clusters 0, 2, 4, and 5) were dominant between the EA and control groups (Figure 7a).
evidence: This is a finding from the endothelial cell subset analysis.

claim: The enriched pathways of DEGs in EC_Cluster0 and EC_Cluster2 exhibited a high degree of overlap and included infectious disease, the immune system, the MAPK signaling pathway, fluid shear stress, and atherosclerosis.
source: The enriched pathways of DEGs in EC_Cluster0 and EC_Cluster2 exhibited a high degree of overlap (Figure 7c and d) and included infectious disease, the immune system, the MAPK signaling pathway, fluid shear stress, and atherosclerosis.
evidence: This is a finding from the pathway enrichment analysis of endothelial cell subsets.

claim: Cluster 0 was enriched in platelet activation, whereas cluster 2 was enriched in the TNF signaling pathway genes.
source: In contrast, cluster 0 was enriched in platelet activation, whereas cluster 2 was enriched in the TNF signaling pathway genes.
evidence: This is a finding from the pathway enrichment analysis distinguishing EC_Cluster0 and EC_Cluster2.

claim: The characteristic expression genes of EC_Cluster4 were mainly involved in immune system-related terms.
source: GO and KEGG results showed that the characteristic expression genes of EC_Cluster4 were mainly involved in immune system-related terms (Figure 7e).
evidence: This is a finding from the GO and KEGG analysis of EC_Cluster4.

claim: The DEGs of EC_Cluster5 are primarily enriched in pathways related to the immune system, infectious diseases, and the regulation of cell population proliferation.
source: Similarly, the DEGs of EC_Cluster5 are primarily enriched in pathways related to the immune system, infectious diseases, and the regulation of cell population proliferation. (Figure 7f).
evidence: This is a finding from the pathway enrichment analysis of EC_Cluster5.

claim: EC_Cluster5 was enriched in the IL-17 signaling pathway, fluid shear stress, and the atherosclerosis pathway, in contrast to EC_Cluster4.
source: In contrast to EC_Cluster4, EC_Cluster5 was also enriched in the interleukin (IL)–17 signaling pathway, fluid shear stress, and the atherosclerosis pathway.
evidence: This is a finding from the pathway enrichment analysis distinguishing EC_Cluster4 and EC_Cluster5.

claim: Neither the upregulated nor downregulated genes of EC_Cluster0 were independent of other clusters, suggesting that this is the basic response of endothelial cells to the effect of EA.
source: Neither the upregulated nor downregulated genes of EC_Cluster0 were independent of other clusters; that is, the differential genes of EC_Cluster0 represented the common influence of EA intervention, suggesting that this is the basic response of endothelial cells to the effect of EA.
evidence: This is an interpretation of the DEG overlap analysis for EC_Cluster0.

claim: Thirty-four genes were significantly upregulated, and 11 genes were significantly downregulated by EA in EC_Cluster0.
source: Thirty-four genes were significantly upregulated, and 11 genes were significantly downregulated by EA in EC_Cluster0 (Figure 8b).
evidence: This is a primary finding from the DEG analysis of EC_Cluster0.

claim: Pathway analysis of EC_Cluster0 revealed downregulation of cellular responses to extracellular stimuli and inflammatory responses.
source: Pathway analysis revealed downregulation of cellular responses to extracellular stimuli and inflammatory responses (Supplementary file 1, Figure 8a and d).
evidence: This is a finding from the pathway enrichment analysis of EC_Cluster0 downregulated genes.

claim: Genes in pathways that involve leukotriene biosynthetic processes, metabolic processes, and synthase activity were downregulated in EC_Cluster0.
source: Genes in pathways that involve leukotriene biosynthetic processes, metabolic processes, and synthase activity were downregulated (Supplementary file 1).
evidence: This is a finding from the pathway enrichment analysis of EC_Cluster0 downregulated genes.

claim: EA-related genes related to interferon signaling were upregulated by EA in EC_Cluster0.
source: We found that EA-related genes related to interferon signaling were upregulated by EA (Figure 8b and Supplementary file 2), which affects brain endothelial function and barrier integrity (Oshima et al., 2001; Zhang et al., 2005; Mbofung et al., 2017).
evidence: This is a finding from the DEG analysis of EC_Cluster0, with citations supporting the functional relevance.

claim: Interferon signaling affects brain endothelial function and barrier integrity.
source: We found that EA-related genes related to interferon signaling were upregulated by EA (Figure 8b and Supplementary file 2), which affects brain endothelial function and barrier integrity (Oshima et al., 2001; Zhang et al., 2005; Mbofung et al., 2017).
evidence: This claim is supported by citations to previous research.

claim: Stip1 regulated the Hsp90ab1 function, and its mRNA was regulated by EA in EC_Cluster0.
source: Interestingly, Stip1 regulated the Hsp90ab1 function (Li et al., 2014), and its mRNA was also regulated by EA in EC_Cluster0 (Supplementary file 2).
evidence: This is a finding from the DEG analysis with a citation supporting the regulatory relationship.

claim: Hsp90b1 and Hsp90ab1 were enriched in the fluid shear stress and atherosclerosis pathways in EC_Cluster0.
source: Notably, Hsp90b1 and Hsp90ab1 were enriched in the fluid shear stress and atherosclerosis pathways (Figure 8c).
evidence: This is a finding from the pathway enrichment analysis of EC_Cluster0 upregulated genes.

claim: The upregulated genes and corresponding functions of EC_Cluster2 were highly correlated with those of EC_Cluster0, with the addition of increased Psap, Mt-co3, Pdia4, and Atrx.1 expression.
source: The upregulated genes and corresponding functions of EC_Cluster2 were highly correlated with those of EC_Cluster0, with the addition of increased Psap, Mt-co3, Pdia4, and Atrx.1 expression (Figure 8g, h, j and Figure 10a) related to the extracellular matrix region and active transmembrane transporter activity (Supplementary file 3).
evidence: This is a finding from the comparative DEG analysis of EC_Cluster2 and EC_Cluster0.

claim: Only 20 genes were downregulated in EC_Cluster2.
source: Only 20 genes were downregulated in EC_Cluster2 (Figure 10b).
evidence: This is a primary finding from the DEG analysis of EC_Cluster2.

claim: Nfkbia, Cxcl10, and Cxcl2 had the highest number of enriched pathways in EC_Cluster2, mainly including the NF-κB signaling pathway, IL-17 signaling pathway, TNF signaling pathway, cytokine-cytokine receptor interaction, and chemokine signaling pathway.
source: Among them, Nfkbia, Cxcl10, and Cxcl2 had the highest number of enriched pathways, mainly including the NF-κB signaling pathway, IL-17 signaling pathway, TNF signaling pathway, cytokine-cytokine receptor interaction, and chemokine signaling pathway (Figure 8f, g and i, and Supplementary file 4).
evidence: This is a finding from the pathway enrichment analysis of EC_Cluster2 downregulated genes.

claim: After EA intervention, 15 unique upregulated genes and 13 downregulated genes were identified in EC_Cluster4.
source: After EA intervention, 15 unique upregulated genes and 13 downregulated genes were identified in EC_Cluster4 (Figure 10).
evidence: This is a primary finding from the DEG analysis of EC_Cluster4.

claim: Downregulated gene enrichment analysis in EC_Cluster4 identified pathways related to BBB transport and barrier function.
source: Importantly, downregulated gene enrichment analysis identified pathways related to BBB transport and barrier function.
evidence: This is a finding from the pathway enrichment analysis of EC_Cluster4 downregulated genes.

claim: Terms and pathways related to the immune response were enriched in EC_Cluster4 downregulated genes.
source: We also observed that terms and pathways related to the immune response were enriched (Figure 9a, b and d, and Supplementary file 5).
evidence: This is a finding from the pathway enrichment analysis of EC_Cluster4 downregulated genes.

claim: The upregulated DEGs in EC_Cluster4 were mainly related to the inflammatory response and involved a variety of cytokine-related signaling pathways.
source: The upregulated DEGs were mainly related to the inflammatory response and involved a variety of cytokine-related signaling pathways.
evidence: This is a finding from the pathway enrichment analysis of EC_Cluster4 upregulated genes.

claim: Several typical signaling pathways were observed in EC_Cluster4 upregulated genes, including the ERK cascade, MAPK, and PI3K pathways.
source: Simultaneously, several typical signaling pathways were also observed, including the ERK cascade, MAPK, and PI3K pathways.
evidence: This is a finding from the pathway enrichment analysis of EC_Cluster4 upregulated genes.

claim: The EA intervention in EC_Cluster4 resulted in changes in vasculogenesis, astrocyte cell migration, pinocytosis, and calcium-mediated signaling.
source: Finally, the EA intervention in EC_Cluster4 also resulted in changes in vasculogenesis, astrocyte cell migration, pinocytosis, and calcium-mediated signaling (Figure 9b, c and e, and Supplementary file 6).
evidence: This is a finding from the pathway enrichment analysis of EC_Cluster4.

claim: Among the downregulated genes in EC_Cluster5, only six genes overlapped with other subgroups, and the remaining 104 genes were downregulated uniquely.
source: Among the downregulated genes in EC_Cluster5, only six genes overlapped with other subgroups, and the remaining 104 genes were downregulated (Figure 10b).
evidence: This is a finding from the DEG overlap analysis of EC_Cluster5.

claim: The downregulated genes in EC_Cluster5 were primarily related to ribosomes, suggesting active changes in protein synthesis and processing.
source: The downregulated genes were primarily related to ribosomes, suggesting active changes in protein synthesis and processing (Supplementary file 7).
evidence: This is a finding from the pathway enrichment analysis of EC_Cluster5 downregulated genes, with an interpretation.

claim: Among the upregulated genes in EC_Cluster5, 21 coincided with other subgroups, and the remaining 44 genes were unique.
source: Among the upregulated genes in EC_Cluster 5, 21 coincided with other subgroups, and the remaining 44 genes (Figure 10a) were enriched in the regulation of the establishment of the BBB, sodium-dependent organic anion transmembrane transporter activity, and sprouting, which are important for BBB formation and material transport, in addition to chemokine activity and immune cell chemotaxis (Figure 9g, h and j, and Supplementary file 8).
evidence: This is a finding from the DEG overlap analysis of EC_Cluster5.

claim: The upregulated genes unique to EC_Cluster5 were enriched in the regulation of the establishment of the BBB, sodium-dependent organic anion transmembrane transporter activity, and sprouting, which are important for BBB formation and material transport.
source: Among the upregulated genes in EC_Cluster 5, 21 coincided with other subgroups, and the remaining 44 genes (Figure 10a) were enriched in the regulation of the establishment of the BBB, sodium-dependent organic anion transmembrane transporter activity, and sprouting, which are important for BBB formation and material transport, in addition to chemokine activity and immune cell chemotaxis (Figure 9g, h and j, and Supplementary file 8).
evidence: This is a finding from the pathway enrichment analysis of EC_Cluster5 upregulated genes.

claim: Analysis of the microglial cell subsets yielded 15 cluster subsets.
source: Analysis of the microglial cell subsets yielded 15 cluster subsets, and marker genes showed different microglial subsets (Figure 11); therefore, these 15 clusters were considered distinct clusters of microglial cells.
evidence: This is a primary finding from the microglial subset analysis.

claim: Six microglial clusters (MG_Cluster0, 1, 2, 3, 5, and 6) with large changes were selected for further analysis.
source: We selected six clusters (MG_Cluster0, 1, 2, 3, 5, and 6) with large changes and annotated marker genes that were differentially expressed among these cell populations.
evidence: This is a statement of the analytical approach for microglial subsets.

claim: MG_Cluster3 had the highest number of upregulated genes (n=52), followed by MG_Cluster6 (n=38).
source: Regarding the quantity of upregulated genes, MG_Cluster3 had the highest number (n=52), followed by MG_Cluster6 (n=38); the numbers in MG_Cluster5 and MG_Cluster0 were 14 and 13, respectively; the number in MG_Cluster2 was seven, while the number in MG_Cluster1 was only one (Figure 14a).
evidence: This is a primary finding from the DEG analysis of microglial subsets.

claim: MG_Cluster5 had the largest number of GO entries independent of the other clusters (n=53).
source: In contrast, GO analysis showed that MG_Cluster5 had the largest number of entries, independent of the other clusters (n=53), followed by MG_Cluster6 and MG_Cluster0, with 18 and 13 entries, respectively.
evidence: This is a finding from the GO enrichment analysis of microglial upregulated genes.

claim: For MG_Cluster0, all activated pathways were similar to those of the other clusters.
source: Regarding the KEGG pathways, for MG_Cluster0, all activated pathways were similar to those of the other clusters.
evidence: This is a finding from the KEGG pathway enrichment analysis of microglial upregulated genes.

claim: The number of upregulated gene enrichment pathways in MG_Cluster1 that do not overlap with other clusters was the largest (13 pathways).
source: In contrast, the number of upregulated gene enrichment pathways in MG_Cluster1 that do not overlap with other clusters was the largest (13 pathways).
evidence: This is a finding from the KEGG pathway enrichment analysis of microglial upregulated genes.

claim: MG_Cluster0 was related to vascular function and functioned as a focal adhesion and synapse.
source: Among them, MG_Cluster0 was related to vascular function. MG_Cluster0 functioned as a focal adhesion and synapse (Figure 14c).
evidence: This is a finding from the functional enrichment analysis of MG_Cluster0 upregulated genes.

claim: GO enrichment in MG_Cluster1 was mainly related to post-translational modifications of proteins.
source: GO enrichment in MG_Cluster1 was mainly related to post-translational modifications of proteins.
evidence: This is a finding from the GO enrichment analysis of MG_Cluster1 upregulated genes.

claim: Hsp90aa1 and Hsp90ab1 in MG_Cluster1 were enriched in the PI3K/Akt signaling pathway.
source: The KEGG results showed that Hsp90aa1 and Hsp90ab1 were also enriched in the PI3K/Akt signaling pathway (Figure 14d and j).
evidence: This is a finding from the KEGG pathway enrichment analysis of MG_Cluster1 upregulated genes.

claim: Upregulated genes in MG_Cluster2 involved the basement membrane and extracellular region.
source: In MG_Cluster2, we identified genes upregulated in the cluster after EA intervention, which involved the basement membrane and extracellular region (Figure 14e and j).
evidence: This is a finding from the functional enrichment analysis of MG_Cluster2 upregulated genes.

claim: Upregulated genes in MG_Cluster3 were mainly enriched in GO terms related to axon and myelin.
source: Upregulated genes in MG_Cluster3 were mainly enriched in GO terms related to axon and myelin.
evidence: This is a finding from the GO enrichment analysis of MG_Cluster3 upregulated genes.

claim: KEGG analysis revealed that MG_Cluster3 was related to ribosomes.
source: KEGG analysis revealed that this cluster was related to ribosomes (Figure 14f and j).
evidence: This is a finding from the KEGG pathway enrichment analysis of MG_Cluster3 upregulated genes.

claim: In MG_Cluster5, the upregulated genes were mainly enriched in the cytosol and plasma membrane.
source: In MG_Cluster5, the upregulated genes were mainly enriched in the cytosol and plasma membrane.
evidence: This is a finding from the GO enrichment analysis of MG_Cluster5 upregulated genes.

claim: The two genes upregulated in MG_Cluster5 (Ccl3 and Ccl4) play key roles in and are mainly enriched in calcium and CCR chemokine receptor-related functions, as well as in the toll-like receptor signaling pathway.
source: Notably, the two genes upregulated in the cluster (Ccl3 and Ccl4) play key roles in and are mainly enriched in calcium and CCR chemokine receptor-related functions, as well as in the toll-like receptor signaling pathway (Figure 14g and k).
evidence: This is a finding from the functional enrichment analysis of MG_Cluster5 upregulated genes.

claim: The enriched pathways in MG_Cluster6 are mostly related to mitochondria after EA intervention.
source: The enriched pathways in MG_Cluster6 are mostly related to mitochondria after EA intervention (Figure 14h and k).
evidence: This is a finding from the pathway enrichment analysis of MG_Cluster6 upregulated genes.

claim: MG_Cluster3 and MG_Cluster6 involved far more independently downregulated genes than the other clusters, with 82 and 68 genes, respectively.
source: We observed that among the six clusters of independently downregulated genes, MG_Cluster3 and MG_Cluster6 involved far more genes than the other clusters, with 82 and 68 genes, respectively.
evidence: This is a finding from the DEG analysis of microglial downregulated genes.

claim: The number of pathways identified in the GO and KEGG enrichments of MG_Cluster6 downregulated genes was higher than those of the other five clusters.
source: The number of pathways identified in the GO and KEGG enrichments of MG_Cluster6 was also higher than those of the other five clusters (Figure 15a, b and l), including the cellular response to various stimuli.
evidence: This is a finding from the enrichment analysis of microglial downregulated genes.

claim: The fluid shear stress and atherosclerosis pathway was a noteworthy pathway in MG_Cluster6 downregulated genes.
source: Another noteworthy pathway was the fluid shear stress and atherosclerosis pathway (Figure 15h and k), because the fluid shear stress generated by directional shear of blood flow directly acts on brain microvascular endothelial cells.
evidence: This is a finding from the pathway enrichment analysis of MG_Cluster6 downregulated genes, with an explanation of its relevance.

claim: The downregulated genes in MG_Cluster0 were mainly associated with focal adhesion, synapses, the response to angiotensin, and positive regulation of angiogenesis.
source: Furthermore, the downregulated genes in MG_Cluster0 were mainly associated with focal adhesion, synapses, the response to angiotensin, and positive regulation of angiogenesis; however, no unique KEGG enrichment pathway was identified (Figure 15c).
evidence: This is a finding from the functional enrichment analysis of MG_Cluster0 downregulated genes.

claim: The G protein-coupled purine nucleotide receptor and platelet activation were the key terms of MG_Cluster1 enriched.
source: The G protein-coupled purine nucleotide receptor and platelet activation were the key terms of MG_Cluster1 enriched (Figure 15d and j).
evidence: This is a finding from the functional enrichment analysis of MG_Cluster1 downregulated genes.

claim: In the unique GO of MG_Cluster3, the regulation of T cell and B cell migration was a focus.
source: In the unique GO of MG_Cluster3, we focused on the regulation of T cell and B cell migration.
evidence: This is a finding from the GO enrichment analysis of MG_Cluster3 downregulated genes.

claim: KEGG analysis of MG_Cluster3 downregulated genes yielded three pathways, including inositol phosphate metabolism, the C-type lectin receptor signaling pathway, and the phosphatidylinositol signaling system.
source: KEGG analysis yielded three pathways, including inositol phosphate metabolism, the C-type lectin receptor signaling pathway, and the phosphatidylinositol signaling system (Figure 15e and l).
evidence: This is a finding from the KEGG pathway enrichment analysis of MG_Cluster3 downregulated genes.

claim: The MG_Cluster5 downregulated genes enriched GO terms and pathways were mainly related to immune function.
source: Finally, the MG_Cluster5 downregulated genes enriched GO terms and pathways were mainly related to immune function (Figure 15f and l).

claim: BAMs, microglia, T cells, granulocytes, and endothelial cells demonstrated obvious differences in their interactions with endothelial cells between the EA and CON groups.
source: Upon comparing the EA and CON groups, we found that BAMs, microglia (MG), T cells, granulocytes, and endothelial cells demonstrated obvious differences in their interactions with endothelial cells (Figure 16a and d).
evidence: This is a finding from the cell-cell communication analysis.

claim: The cells with the most active relationship with endothelial cells were astrocytes, fibroblasts, and endothelial cells.
source: The results suggested that the cells with the most active relationship with endothelial cells were astrocytes, fibroblasts, and endothelial cells, whereas the largest changes between the two groups were granulocytes (GC) (Figure 16b, e, g and h).
evidence: This is a finding from the cell-cell communication analysis.

claim: The largest changes in cell-cell interactions between the EA and CON groups were in granulocytes.

claim: TNFRSF21_APP was present only in the CON group, whereas CSF1R_CSF1 was specifically present in the EA group.

claim: The EA intervention activated the ligand-receptor interaction of CD74_APP.

claim: Apart from the higher mean PLXNB2_PTN in the EA group than that in the CON group in fibroblast-endothelial cell communication, all other ligand-receptor pairs with mean changes were higher in the CON group.
